// COMMON QUESTIONS
Answers to what people ask before they sign up.
Is there a free trial?
Yes. Contact us and we'll set you up with a 14-day Observer key at no cost so you can explore the full system before committing.
How do I actually access the platform?
You get an API key sent to you after signup. Add it as a header in your API client or integrate it into your code. The User Guide walks you through it step by step.
Can my whole team use one key?
You can, but we recommend individual keys per person. Each key is separately tracked and can be revoked independently — better security for your operation.
Is my data safe?
All data is stored in an encrypted PostgreSQL database. Connections are TLS-secured. Every key is individually managed. Access logs are maintained.
Does this guarantee I'll win contracts?
No platform can guarantee award — that's the CO's decision. What we do is make your pipeline cleaner, your submissions faster, and your data organized so you can submit more bids with less effort.
What's included in enterprise/Architect pricing?
Custom onboarding, dedicated support, the full DIV10-BOT intelligence engine, and system-level access. Contact us to discuss your operation's needs.
